title: Collection
description: A versioned set of entries of one type, the unit of sync with the future API.

version.description: Bumped by hand whenever the content changes.

MartialArt.description:
A martial art with its techniques; `kind: general` holds the techniques of every style.
Server content: texts are in the language of the server the data came from.

pack.description: Content pack the entry belongs to: `core` (the main book) or `dlc:<code>`.

summary.description: One phrase: what the style is about, shown in hints.

MartialArtKind.description: How a martial art plays: the general techniques every style may use, or a soft or hard style.

oneOf.description: Techniques open to every style; not a style to pick on the sheet.

Source.description: Where a value comes from in the rulebook.

page.description: Printed page number (PDF page minus one).

StatKey.description: Stat a skill is linked to (same names as the fields of `character::Stats`).

StatRequirement.description: A stat the technique asks for ("ВОЛЯ 8 или больше").

Technique.description:
A special move of a martial art (p. 179-180). The app only shows it: the GM decides when the
condition is met and rolls the check.

condition.description: What has to be true first, as printed, in the content language; `None` when there is none.

dv.description: DV of the check the move asks for, when it has one.

effect.description: What the move does, in the content language.

injuries.description: Critical injuries the move inflicts: ids from the critical injury table.

requires.description: Stat threshold of the condition, when it has one.
